web.badgeTitle.zh-Hant-TW: 目前星系的來源：示範資料、AI 生成，或由 Claude Code（MCP）傳入
web.badgeTitle.en: Where the current galaxy came from: demo data, AI-generated, or sent from Claude Code (MCP)

web.goalPlaceholder.zh-Hant-TW: 輸入一句還沒想清楚的目標，按 Enter 讓右邊選的 AI 整理出 12 個觀點…
web.goalPlaceholder.en: Type a goal you're still unsure about and press Enter; the AI selected on the right will lay out 12 ideas…

web.providerTitle.zh-Hant-TW: 用哪個 AI 生成星系：本機已登入的 CLI（免 API key），或設定了 API key 的供應商
web.providerTitle.en: Which AI generates the galaxy: a CLI you're already signed in to on this machine (no API key needed), or a provider with an API key set

web.modelTitle.zh-Hant-TW: 模型 ID；可從清單選，或直接輸入
web.modelTitle.en: Model ID; pick from the list or type one

web.spawnTitle.zh-Hant-TW: 用選定的 AI 依你的目標整理出 12 個觀點的星系（通常 1–4 分鐘）
web.spawnTitle.en: Have the selected AI lay out a new 12-idea galaxy for your goal (usually 1–4 minutes)

web.doneSub.zh-Hant-TW: 你選的方案已轉成一段 AI 看得懂的指令。
web.doneSub.en: Your chosen plan has been turned into instructions an AI can follow.

web.donePasteStep.zh-Hant-TW: 貼到 Claude Code 或 ChatGPT 的對話框送出。AI 會照「要做」動手、避開「不做」，遇到「護欄」條件就停下來回報，不會自己改方向。
web.donePasteStep.en: Paste it into a Claude Code or ChatGPT chat and send.The AI will act on the “do” items, avoid the “don't” items, and stop to report back when a “guardrail” condition comes up instead of changing direction on its own.

web.copyFailed.en: Copy failed — please select it manually

web.doneCopyManual.zh-Hant-TW: 請手動複製下方指令瀏覽器沒有允許自動複製。
web.doneCopyManual.en: Please copy the instructions below manuallyThe browser didn't allow automatic copying.

web.doneLockSaved.zh-Hant-TW: 已存成 .intent.lock.json，記錄這次決定。{date}（14 天後）會提醒你驗收：護欄的失效條件有沒有發生。{hookHint}
web.doneLockSaved.en: Saved as .intent.lock.json to record this decision.On {date} (in 14 days) you'll be reminded to review whether any guardrail's failure condition has occurred.{hookHint}

web.doneHookHint.zh-Hant-TW: 要自動提醒，請先在專案執行 npx @stephen.taipei/intent-galaxy init-hook。
web.doneHookHint.en: For automatic reminders, first run npx @stephen.taipei/intent-galaxy init-hook in your project.

web.doneLockLater.zh-Hant-TW: 14 天後回來檢查：護欄的失效條件有沒有發生。
web.doneLockLater.en: Come back in 14 days to check whether any guardrail's failure condition has occurred.
